title: DGSSA: Domain generalization with structural and stylistic augmentation for retinal vessel segmentation
mechanism: Structural augmentation (space-colonisation vessel trees rendered by Pix2Pix) plus stylistic augmentation (PixMix, uncertainty perturbations) for thin-vessel DG.
evidence: DeepLabv3+ MobileNetV2; DSC 78.45 DRIVE, 78.62 CHASEDB1, 72.66 HRF, 82.17 STARE (avg 77.98), better than prior DG methods.
adaptation: Use the style half: PixMix with EL-like mixing images (fractals, finger patterns, pool cells). The structure half (synthetic crack trees rendered into cells) belongs to D06.
min_experiment: PF+PixMix-EL vs PF, 5 seeds; metric E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: < +0.02.
prior_overlap: None for style mixing; crack copy-paste (n.d.) differs from rendered structures.

alt_notes.adaptation: PixMix half is cheap: mix EL cells with fractal or pool images at low weight. Structural half = synthetic branching crack masks rendered into cells (overlaps CrackSegFlow row).
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + PixMix vs PF, 3 seeds; kill at < +0.02 E1 crack relF1@2.
